WITH pagamentos_filtrados AS (
  SELECT
    ec.nom_credor,
    SUM(CAST(dp.vlr_movimentacao AS DECIMAL)) AS total_pago
  FROM despesa_pagamento dp
  JOIN empenho_credorEmpenho ec
    ON dp.seq_empenho = ec.seq_empenho
    AND dp.ano_referencia = ec.ano_referencia
  WHERE dp.ano_referencia = 2025
    AND COALESCE(ec.nom_credor, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%'
    AND COALESCE(ec.nom_credor, '') != ''
    AND COALESCE(ec.num_doc_credor, '') NOT IN ('-1', '0', '')
  GROUP BY ec.nom_credor
)
SELECT nom_credor, total_pago
FROM pagamentos_filtrados
ORDER BY total_pago DESC
LIMIT 10;
